## Description
 Potassium Hydroxide (KOH). Used for&#10;&#9;&#9;liquid soap production. Also for food processing, such as curing olives and making certain types of noodles.&#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;The &quot;K₂O industry&quot; is really the potash industry: mine sylvite/carnallite → float or leach KCl &#10;&#9;&#9;→ convert to KOH (electrolysis), K₂SO₄ (Mannheim), or K₂CO₃ as needed. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;Pure K₂O is a laboratory curiosity at scale; in glass, cement, and fertilizer it exists only &#10;&#9;&#9;as a bookkeeping convention for the potassium content. &#10;&#9;&#9;
